config-enable-crucible-indicators-toolti: Show metal amount in filled crucibles and crucibles in the firepit input slot. Applies immediately.
config-enable-crucible-effect-tooltip: Show angular solid metal and glowing molten sloshing. Disable to retain a plain amount indicator. Applies immediately.
config-crucible-indicator-capacity-units: Metal units represented by a full indicator. This is a visual reference, not a game capacity limit. Default: 2560 units (four stacks of 128 five-unit nuggets). Applies immediately.
config-enable-tool-mode-radial-menu-tool: Replace base-game tool-mode grids with a radial menu.
config-enable-perishable-item-freshness-: Show freshness on perishable item slots using the selected indicator style.
quicktool-rejected: That quick-tool selection is no longer available.
quicktool-interrupted: The swap was interrupted. Your current items were kept; restoration is no longer available.
quicktool-session-unavailable: The previous item can no longer be restored.
quicktool-menu-unavailable: The quick-tool menu could not be opened.
quicktool-binding-unavailable: Bind Quick tools to a keyboard key or the middle or right mouse button.
gui-alloycalculator-dropdown-tooltip: Select the alloy type you want to create
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-tooltip: Transfer required ingredients and the minimum fuel needed to fully smelt them
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-fuel-invalid: The crucible does not contain smeltable metal.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-fuel-invento: The crucible is no longer open.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-fuel-insuffi: You do not have enough suitable fuel.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-inventory-cl: The crucible is no longer open.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-invalid-reci: The requested mixture is not a valid alloy.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-insufficient: You do not have enough ingredients.
There is not enough inventory space to rearrange the crucible.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-transfer-fai: The deposit failed and all inventory changes were restored.
config-enable-auto-stash-tooltip: Enable auto-stashing items into containers by holding the interact key.
config-enable-ignition-tools-tooltip: Enable lighting fires using lanterns, candles, and oil lamps.
config-enable-spawn-decal-tooltip: Show a glowing decal at the player's respawn point.
config-enable-alloy-calculator-tooltip: Enable the alloy calculator GUI for crucibles.
config-disable-alloy-calculator-patch-to: Disable the Harmony patch that detects firepit GUI changes. Requires re-entering the world or restarting.
config-enable-equip-light-hotkey-tooltip: Enable the hotkey to equip light sources to offhand/hotbar.
config-quick-tool-select-on-release-tool: Select the hovered quick-tool entry when the activation key is released.
config-auto-stash-delay-tooltip: Time in seconds to hold the interact key before auto-stashing begins.
config-ignition-delay-tooltip: Time in seconds to hold the interact key before igniting a fire.
config-spawn-decal-size-tooltip: Size of the spawn point decal (0.2 to 1.0).
config-perishable-item-freshness-indicat: Background: bottom-up freshness fill. Outline: complete border colored by freshness. Horizontal bar: bottom track filled left to right by freshness. Changes take effect immediately.
Opacity of perishable item freshness indicators (0.05 to 1.00).
config-auto-stash-gui-renders-topmost-to: Render the auto-stash progress bar above dialogs and other game UI.
config-enable-backpack-decraft-tooltip: Enable decrafting backpacks into leather using knife or shears.
config-enable-linensack-decraft-tooltip: Enable decrafting linen sacks into flax fibers using knife or shears.
config-enable-metalbits-recycling-toolti: Enable recycling metal tool heads into metal bits using a chisel.
config-enable-stick-recipes-tooltip: Enable crafting sticks from planks and firewood.
config-enable-wattle-decraft-tooltip: Enable decrafting wattle blocks into sticks.
config-enable-preparation-indicators-too: Show preparation progress overlays on item slots. Changes take effect immediately.
config-enable-clothing-indicators-toolti: Show clothing condition overlays on item slots. Changes take effect immediately.
config-enable-liquid-slosh-effect-toolti: Animate liquid container and watering-can indicators. Disable to retain plain volume fills and pause the liquid simulation. Changes take effect immediately.
config-enable-food-grain-effect-tooltip: Show animated food-amount particles on meal containers. Disable to hide particles and pause their simulation while retaining freshness indicators. Changes take effect immediately.
config-enable-liquid-container-indicator: Show liquid volume overlays on liquid containers and watering cans. Changes take effect immediately.
config-enable-night-vision-fuel-indicato: Show night-vision fuel overlays on item slots. Changes take effect immediately.
config-tool-mode-menu-size-tooltip: Scale the tool-mode radial menu from 0.15 to 2.5. 1 keeps the default size. Changes take effect immediately.
config-quick-swap-menu-size-tooltip: Scale the quick-swap radial menu from 0.15 to 2.5. 1 keeps the default size. Changes take effect immediately.
